war_declared.text: The council has voted for war with {enemy_faction}. I opposed it gently, which is why nobody heard me.
{my_faction} goes to war with {enemy_faction}. I did say the vote would be unanimous. I never said whose.
Banners are raised against {enemy_faction}. I have already drafted the letter explaining why it was all my idea.
Well. {enemy_faction} is now declared an enemy of {my_faction}. I shall write the wording myself, to be correct.

peace_made.text: Terms with {faction} are agreed. I brokered them over three dinners and will not be thanked for it.
{my_faction} and {faction} are at peace. Do ask me how, but only if you have an afternoon free.
The council accepted peace with {faction}. A fine result. Patience outlasted the swords, as it so often does.
Peace with {faction} is signed. Curious how some lords still call that a defeat.

player_joined_my_faction.text: {player} has sworn to {my_faction}. A wise choice, and a patient one. I am rather pleased.
Do come find me, {player}. There is much to discuss about {my_faction} before the next council.
{player} joins {my_faction}. I shall reserve judgement until I see how they vote.
{player}, you have joined {my_faction}. I wish you every success. I hope you read the charter first.

player_left_my_faction.text: {player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. I wish them joy of it. Loyalty is a luxury some can afford once.
You left us for {faction}, {player}. I shall not raise my voice. I never do, and you know why.
{player} has gone over to {faction}. Such moves are always discussed carefully, usually over wine.
I understand why you went to {faction}, {player}. Ambition is a poor master, yet an honest one.

player_granted_fief.text: {player} now holds {fief}. Well deserved, I think. I did argue for it, though I shall not say so loudly.
{fief} has gone to {player}. How generous the council feels this season. I wonder what was promised.
Congratulations on {fief}, {player}. I trust you will keep its ledgers in better order than the last steward.
So {fief} went to you, {player}. I would have liked a word first. Still, the council rarely asks me.

whisper_alliance_offer.text: {player}, {enemy_faction} is no friend of ours, and I suspect {rival} has been counting on that.
Keep this between us, {player}. {enemy_faction} is a problem that patient people solve together.
{player}, {rival} has been undermining us both. Stand with me against {enemy_faction}. Let us see who is left.
I am offering this to you alone, {player}. A common stand against {enemy_faction} would be wise.

my_faction_took_fief.text: {fief} is ours again, taken from {enemy_faction} with hardly a death. Efficiency is a kind of mercy.
{my_faction} now holds {fief}. The council will be told it was a battle. I shall say it was a negotiation.
The banners of {my_faction} fly over {fief}. {enemy_faction} will mourn it and blame the weather.
{fief} has changed hands. Those who swore {enemy_faction} would never yield it were not paying attention.

player_took_my_fief.text: {player} has taken {fief} from us. Bold. I do hope they enjoy the upkeep, which I shall mention at council.
{player}, you have {fief} now. I shall remember this, and so will the council, though only one of us says so.
{fief} changed hands under {player}. A clever move. I would call it sporting, if I were the sporting sort.
Well played, {player}, taking {fief}. I was fond of it, but I know a fair trade when I see one.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Yes, {player}, I accept. Against {enemy_faction} we shall do very well. Just keep {rival} from hearing of it first.
I accept your proposal, {player}. A useful arrangement. We shall see how it reads once the council has had its say.
Gladly, {player}. Let us make this formal before {enemy_faction} notices how well we get along.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No, {player}. I thank you for asking, but I have seen how you treat your allies. I would not wish that on mine.
I must decline, {player}. Not out of spite. My calendar is simply full of things {rival} has yet to explain.
I am sorry, {player}, but no. Our friendship is worth more than a hasty pact. Return when {rival} has left the room.
Refused, {player}. Pleasant as it is to be asked, I have not forgotten who sat silent during the last vote.

ambient_chatter.text: The rain over {town} has made the council benches damp again. Someone should complain, and I suppose it will be me.
Has anyone heard how {village} voted on the new road tolls? I have opinions, naturally, but I want theirs first.
The roads to {town} are muddy, a pity for the envoys. Mud has never once stopped a good argument, though.
Debts from the granary loans are never discussed in council. Some of us keep very good ledgers, all the same.
